name: Peloton

fastest.text: Go to account.onepeloton.com/mymembership, select Manage next to your membership, then Pause or cancel.

steps: Go to account.onepeloton.com/mymembership in a web browser and sign in.
Under Memberships, select Manage next to the membership you want to end.
Select Pause or cancel, then choose to cancel.
You can keep taking classes until the end of your current billing period.
note: Got the Peloton App through Google Play or Roku? Cancel it there; Peloton's website can't cancel those.

faq.a: Yes. An All-Access Membership can be paused for 1, 2 or 3 months from the same Pause or cancel option. While it's paused you can't take classes.
At the end of your current billing period. You can reactivate any time from your Bike, Tread or Row or on the website.
Only for a charge made in error, and only if you tell Peloton Member Support within 60 days of it.
